Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce WRECKIN' BALL ADVENTURE - a brand new release by No Gravity Games!

Wreckin' Ball Adventure is a family-friendly platformer for up to 4 players, with ball-shaped robots and physics-based puzzles. 
You are a ball to jump, swing and wreck your way to freedom!

Get it 30% OFF now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/746030/Wreckin_Ball_Adventure/

notes.title: A gentle grooming – game update incoming!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/cbc2c6b97e9cc731f84cb22d4a25ac757b8ee0b7.jpg[/img]
All paws are on board to make your Nyanya experience even more amazing, fantastic and awesome. Today, we're presenting to you an update that will surely smooth out your quest to rip the nazi furniture to splinters.

Here are the three main fixes:
[list]
 [*]Your PC is a tad slow? Say no more! The graphics are now OPTIMIZED for slower machines.
 [*]The game doesn't start after shutting it down without restarting your PC? I don't know what are you talking about.
 [*]Fullscreen – we haz it.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy your epic Catsassin adventure full of feline friends, memes and funnies. More updates coming soon!
